President’s Message

Shri Ashok kumar Pukhraj Jain

It gives me immense pleasure as I reflect back on the memories of the events that had taken place in our esteemed association during my tenure. The events of this past year has allowed me to learn that teamwork is the ability to work together toward a common vision and it is the fuel that allows common people to attain uncommon results. I would like to take this opportunity in thanking my colleagues - the office bearers and the committee members of our association for their whole hearted cooperation and active involvement in making our CWJA flag reach new heights!

Believing in the fact that “Success is never permanent and failure is never final”, in spite of a few setbacks and ups and downs, our team was able to attain certain accomplishments and noteworthy achievements for our association following the stepping stones of foundation stage set by our great predecessors.

Gem & Jewellery India International Fair

With a humble beginning of over 500 booths from across India in 2018, GJIIF has now grown to become the largest exclusive B2B jewellery tradeshow for South India with over 1200+ booths from over 25 cities covering over 10 states.

GJIIF has become the platform for jewellery sourcing in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and International buyers from Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Singapore, UAE and Malaysia.
